LanguageData.RHA_STAR_Skill_Return013.nodes.0.label: Return Trail
LanguageData.RHA_STAR_Skill_Return013.nodes.0.descrip: Requires Return learned from its augment card. Retains the original return point, lifetime, range and cooldown; the tree neither teaches the skill nor creates a return point.
LanguageData.RHA_STAR_Skill_Return013.nodes.1.label: Retreat Guard
LanguageData.RHA_STAR_Skill_Return013.nodes.1.descrip: After successfully casting Return, gain a separate 50-point shield for 3 seconds, once per 8 seconds. Missing return points, failed casts and other movement do not trigger it. Base rewards: shield 50.
LanguageData.RHA_STAR_Skill_Return013.nodes.2.label: Breathing Room
LanguageData.RHA_STAR_Skill_Return013.nodes.2.descrip: After successfully casting Return, heal 40 base points of your own recoverable injuries, once per 8 seconds. Missing parts and permanent scars are not restored; an uninjured caster receives no healing. Base rewards: healing 40.
LanguageData.RHA_STAR_Skill_Return013.nodes.3.label: Retreating Edge
LanguageData.RHA_STAR_Skill_Return013.nodes.3.descrip: A successful Return stores one counterattack for 5 seconds, at most one, once per 8 seconds. Your next ordinary hit consumes it for 50 bonus damage; secondary damage cannot consume or renew it. Base rewards: damage 50.
LanguageData.RHA_STAR_Skill_Return013.nodes.4.label: Return Cover
LanguageData.RHA_STAR_Skill_Return013.nodes.4.descrip: After a successful Return, shield the nearest other eligible colonist within 4 cells of the landing and clear sight for 50 points over 3 seconds, once per 8 seconds. With no eligible ally it does not shield you instead. Base rewards: shield 50.
LanguageData.RHA_STAR_Skill_Return013.nodes.5.label: Shared Recovery
LanguageData.RHA_STAR_Skill_Return013.nodes.5.descrip: After Breathing Room actually heals your injury, heal 20 base injury points on the most injured other eligible colonist within 4 cells of you and clear sight, once per 8 seconds. No actual self-healing means no ally healing. Base rewards: healing 20.
LanguageData.RHA_STAR_Skill_Return013.nodes.6.label: Regained Guard
LanguageData.RHA_STAR_Skill_Return013.nodes.6.descrip: After Breathing Room actually heals your injury, gain a separate 50-point shield for 3 seconds, once per 8 seconds. Returning while uninjured cannot trigger this shield. Base rewards: shield 50.
